name: Outdoor metal Corner Garden Set
material: Nylon-look webbing fabric w/t steel frame powder coated. w/t polyester fabric cushion. Coffee table w/t 5mm black silk screen printing glass
description: This 4-piece garden set brings comfort and elegance to your outdoor space. It consists of a coffee table and a modular corner sofa with seat and back cushions. Ideal for terraces, balconies or gardens, it makes it easy to create a pleasant relaxation area. The padded cushions and decorative armrests ensure a high level of comfort. In addition, the materials used are weatherproof, UV and rain resistant, guaranteeing optimal durability.
